sentence_stem: Although the contract had been signed,
correct_completion: the buyer refused to pay the final installment.
full_sentence: Although the contract had been signed, the buyer refused to pay the final installment.
acceptable_variants: the buyer still refused to pay the final installment.
the seller nevertheless delivered the goods late.

options.text: so the seller had to cancel the order.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result, but 'although' sets up a contrast, so this result does not fit the connector.

options.text: the buyer refused to pay the final installment.
because the lawyers reviewed each clause.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a cause. 'Although' needs a contrast, so this clause clashes with the connector.

options.text: the contract was written in English.
options.why_wrong: This adds a fact about the contract, but it does not express the contrast that 'although' requires.

explanation: After 'although', the clause must contrast with the first part of the sentence. A signed contract creates the expectation that the buyer will pay, so a refusal completes the contrast. Learners often choose a cause connector here, so remember that 'although' always marks concession, not reason.
translation: Aunque el contrato había sido firmado, el comprador se negó a pagar la última cuota.
